about: Rows the checker evaluates. Signal kinds: blocker (issue: open = broken), fix (PR: merged = fixed, open = in review), release (owner/repo@tag published = fixed), code (owner/repo:path on the default branch; a regex that means fixed or broken), context (shown, never decides), manual (a dated note with a link). Evidence verified 2026-10-24; rows added and re-verified 2026-10-28.

rows.name: Trust Wallet Core
rows.note: Builds only v4 Zcash transactions, which NU7 made invalid. Apps that rely on it for Zcash can't send transparent ZEC until a v5 release ships. An open PR (#4934, 5 Nov) adds transparent v5 signing. Vultisig added its own v5 code instead (#6151).

signals.label: Grant application for a Wallet Core v5 repair (under review)

rows.name: Vultisig: SwapKit ZEC swaps
rows.note: SwapKit now builds ZEC swaps as v5 with the NU7 branch ID (read 6 Nov on its Maya, THORChain and Flashnet routes; its NEAR route wasn't tested). Vultisig's SwapKit signers still accept only v4 (Android 1.0.124, iOS 1.50.80), so from the code these swaps stop with an error before signing and no funds move. Normal sends and THORChain or Maya swaps outside SwapKit moved to v5 in #6151, and #6115 was closed on that basis.

signals.label: iOS signer accepts Sapling v4 only
Closed 6 Nov; #6151 left the SwapKit path unchanged
v5 for sends and THORChain/Maya swaps, not SwapKit
Grant application for v5 swap signing (under review)

rows.name: SwapKit: Trezor ZEC signing
rows.note: Trezor signs SwapKit's Zcash sends and swaps as v5, so ZEC received in v6 transactions can be spent. Merged 3 Nov in #216, which carries #189.

rows.name: Zaino (light-wallet indexer)
rows.note: Reported on 1 Nov: Zaino 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 stop at the last block before NU7 with "invalid consensus branch id", reproduced on a Zebra 7.0.0 regtest chain, so Mainnet deployments would stall the same way. The reporter verified that the open PR fixes it, but it isn't merged or released yet.

rows.name: Trezor Suite and Blockbook (ZEC)
rows.note: Blockbook's Zcash config still pins Zebra 6.2.2, and its open PR says both backends need 7.0.0 before activation. Suite's fallback branch ID is also still NU6.3, used only when neither the caller nor Blockbook gives one. Trezor's own servers may already be updated; that can't be seen publicly.

rows.name: Trezor firmware: v4 signing cleanup
rows.note: Trezor plans to stop signing v4 Zcash transactions after NU7 (they become invalid under ZIP 2003). Trezor rates it low priority with no funds at risk: Suite always asks for v5, so only third-party apps that request v4 would get a transaction the network rejects.

signals.label: Drop v4 signing after NU7 (low priority)

rows.name: Zondax Ledger app (ledger-zcash)
rows.note: No NU7 change found in the repository. Its NU6.3 branch-ID update has been open since 8 Sep. Shielded Ledger work has moved to LedgerHQ/app-zcash and pczt-ledger, which this row doesn't track yet.

rows.name: Noir Wallet
rows.note: v1.0.41 (4 Nov) packages the Zcash wallet for NU7 Mainnet at height 3,543,405. Testnet sends failed on earlier releases; a Free Society Hack team reported a Testnet send working on v1.0.41 the same day. Mainnet and Testnet are separate builds, so users need the right one at 1.0.41 or later.

rows.name: Zingo (zingolib)
rows.note: Testnet wallets failed with "invalid consensus branch id 0x77190ad9" after Testnet NU7; that was fixed, and zingolib 8.0.0 (29 Oct) moves to the librustzcash NU7 release crates with the Mainnet height. Apps built on zingolib still have to ship their own update.

rows.name: Zodl Android SDK
rows.note: The SDK's main branch moved to the final NU7 crates (zcash_protocol 0.11.0, which carries the Mainnet height) on 28 Oct, and release 6.0.0 is on Maven Central (published 30 Oct).

signals.label: Main on the final NU7 crates (zcash_protocol 0.11.0)

rows.name: Edge
rows.note: Edge moved off react-native-zcash to its new zcash-native package, on the NU7 zingolib base (merged 4 Nov), and the app moved to it on 5 Nov. Release tag v4.52.3 pins zcash-native 0.1.1, so users are fine once they have that version.

signals.label: Earlier PR, closed in favour of zcash-native

rows.name: Zapp (iOS SDK fork)
rows.note: The open PR signs Testnet transactions with the librustzcash NU7 pre-releases; a Mainnet build is a separate step.

rows.name: WebZjs (MetaMask Snap)
rows.note: Still built on ChainSafe's NU6.1 fork of librustzcash (last commit April 2026), so it has neither NU6.3 nor NU7; a user reported in June that shielding is rejected for an incorrect consensus branch ID. Mari of red·dev said on the forum it would be redeployed after NU7.

signals.label: Built on an NU6.1 librustzcash fork

rows.name: ZNS mint
rows.note: Moved to the final NU7 crates (zcash_protocol 0.11, which carries the Mainnet height) in a PR merged 26 Oct; the older tracking issue was closed on 29 Oct.

rows.name: NEAR Omni Bridge: ZEC
rows.note: The NU7 height is a contract constant. Both contracts are deployed on NEAR with it: zcash-connector.bridge.near reports version 0.9.8, and the code on zcash-client.bridge.near matches the btc-light-client v0.6.1 release byte for byte (checked 30 Oct).

rows.name: THORChain ZEC
rows.note: ZEC trading was halted around 19 Oct after an outbound matching bug; the fix is in THORChain v3.21.0 (about 23 Oct). No NU7-specific notice found.

rows.name: Maya Protocol ZEC
rows.note: The network halted after a 19 Aug exploit, yet a Maya ZEC route was still quoted on 23 Oct. The sources conflict; treat the route as unconfirmed.

rows.name: sovright mining-infra
rows.note: Open checklist of mining-infrastructure work to finish before Mainnet activation. The final NU7 crates and the pre-activation peer floor merged on 26 Oct (#128, #129); 16 of 27 checklist items were still open on 30 Oct, including relay and pool-server qualification on NU7 blocks.

rows.name: BitGo (wasm-utxo)
rows.note: The NU7 branch ID and Mainnet height are in wasm-utxo (5.15.0 and later), and BitGoJS moved to that version in a PR merged 22 Oct, which also fixed old Zcash recovery defaults.

rows.name: Valar librustzcash fork: early NU7 ID PR
rows.note: A PR to Valar's librustzcash fork proposed exposing NU7 as 0x77190AD8; the final ID is 0x77190AD9. It was closed without merging on 27 Oct and the fork's main branch never carried it, so only code built straight from that PR branch would have the wrong value.

rows.name: librustzcash crates
rows.note: The NU7 Mainnet crate releases are out; wallets built on them still have to ship their own releases.

rows.name: Zebra node
rows.note: Zebra 7.0.0 activates NU7 at 3,543,405 and is supported for 8 weeks. Zebra 6.4.x stops itself around 2 Nov, so nodes must upgrade before then.

rows.name: Keystone 3 firmware
rows.note: Works after NU7 as it is: NU7 changes no transaction format or signing algorithm, and the PCZTs Keystone signs carry the target branch ID themselves (str4d, 29 Oct). A PR moving the firmware to the NU7 crates is open anyway.

signals.label: str4d: existing firmware will work fine post-NU7

rows.name: KeepKey firmware
rows.note: Firmware 7.16.0 (a pre-release, 28 Oct) signs Ironwood and Orchard-to-Ironwood spends only under the NU6.3 branch ID 0x37A5165B, so it refuses them under NU7's 0x77190AD9. No NU7 change in the repository.

signals.label: Ironwood signing requires the NU6.3 branch ID

rows.name: Unstoppable Wallet (Android)
rows.note: Moved to Zodl Android SDK 6.0.0, on the final NU7 crates, on 2 Nov on both its master and develop branches. App version 0.53.1 (4 Nov) includes it, so users are fine once they are on 0.53.1 or later. GitHub marks 0.53.1 as a pre-release, and the Play Store version hasn't been checked.

rows.name: Unstoppable Wallet (iOS)
rows.note: Moved to its fork of Zodl Swift SDK 7.0.0 (7.0.0-hs.2) for NU7 in a PR merged 29 Oct, with app version 0.53.1, which the App Store has listed since 2 Nov.

rows.name: Zodl iOS (Swift SDK)
rows.note: Swift SDK 7.0.0 (28 Oct) moves to the final NU7 crates (zcash_protocol 0.11.0), which carry the Mainnet activation height. The Zodl iOS app builds on a private copy of the SDK, but App Store version 3.19.0 (29 Oct) lists NU7 support in its release notes.

signals.label: str4d: the app update is in the pipeline

rows.name: Zcash Android and Swift SDKs (original, MIT)
rows.note: 4.0.0 is the final release and support ends at NU7 (ZODL, 22 Oct). Both stay on pre-NU7 librustzcash (zcash_protocol 0.10; the Swift SDK patches in an 7 Aug revision where NU7 has no Mainnet height), so apps still built on them can't send now unless they move to the ZODL SDKs or patch it themselves.

signals.label: Swift SDK on a 7 Aug librustzcash revision
ZODL: end of support for the original SDKs at NU7

rows.name: ShapeShift
rows.note: Zcash sends use a fixed NU6.3 branch ID (0x37a5165b) in hdwallet-core, so NU7 nodes reject them. Cryppit filed the issue.

rows.name: Zallet (zcashd wallet replacement)
rows.note: Moved to the released NU7 crates and Zebra 7.0.0 in a PR merged 30 Oct, and 0.1.0-beta.4 (2 Nov) is the first release with them.

rows.name: Ledger Live
rows.note: Ledger Live's Zcash signer uses device-signer-kit-zcash 0.9.0, which signs Mainnet transparent transactions under the NU7 branch ID from the activation height. It ships in Ledger Live 4.25.0 (desktop and mobile, 22 Oct).

rows.name: Ledger hw-app-btc (JS library)
rows.note: The older hw-app-btc Zcash path picks the branch ID by height and stops at NU6.3, so apps that still sign ZEC through it (ShapeShift patches it) send NU6.3 transactions, which NU7 nodes reject. Ledger Live itself moved to the new signer kit.

rows.name: NEAR omni-transaction-rs
rows.note: NEAR's transaction builder for chain signatures lists Zcash branch IDs up to NU6.3 and has no NU7 entry. Callers can pass a custom ID, so whether an app breaks depends on what it passes.

rows.name: Defuse Labs utxo-lib
rows.note: The UTXO library of NEAR Intents' builders last moved its Zcash branch ID to NU6.3 (18 Aug) and has nothing for NU7. Whether NEAR Intents' ZEC withdrawals still use it is not public.

signals.label: Zcash default branch ID is NU6.3

rows.name: ZelCore utxo-lib
rows.note: ZelCore's UTXO library defaults Zcash to the NU6.3 branch ID at most, with no NU7 change or issue. Whether the ZelCore app passes its own branch ID is not visible.

signals.label: Zcash default branch ID is NU6.3
